des.es: del, de la (genitivo masculino y neutro)

texto: With masculine and neutral: **des** (of, of the thing): **des Vaters** (of the father), **des Hauses** (of the house). With feminine: **der** (of the): **der Frau** (of the woman). In plural: **der** (from, from): **der Kinder** (from children).
The masculine and neutral names add **-s** or **-es**: **des Mannes**, **des Kindes**. Eye: feminine and plural do not change the form of the name.

The first possessed name and the later possessor are placed in genius: **Das Auto meines Freundes** (my friend's car). In the daily speech, more **das Auto von meinem Freund** (with «von» and dative) is said, but the genitive is more formal and very common in texts.

Some masculine names add **-(e)n** in almost all cases: **der Kollege, den Kollegen, dem Kollegen, des Kollegen**. It also occurs with **der Kunde** and **der Student**. Learn these forms with the article; not all masculine follow this pattern.
